title: Prenuvo reveal
description: A wrapper that fades its content in and lifts it 64, 80 or 96px into place as it scrolls into view, driven by the scroll itself (CSS view timeline). Give items in a row a step number to stagger them.
notes: CSS only: browsers without scroll-driven animations, and reduced motion, show the content in place
don't put it inside an overflow-hidden box (use overflow-clip), or the timeline freezes
